purpose: Reconcile sample-size counts that appear throughout the manuscript and analysis tables.

lineage.label: raw_cwfis_2000_2024
lineage.source: Canadian Wildland Fire Information System (CWFIS) National Fire Database (NFDB) perimeters, 2000-2024
lineage.note: Full national perimeter shapefile; n not recorded in repo (~110 MB raw, excluded from git per GitHub size limit; available via Zenodo deposit 10.5281/zenodo.20389084).

lineage.label: filter_intersects_bc_bbox_and_2000_2024
lineage.filter: YEAR in [2000, 2024] AND LATITUDE in [48.30, 60.00] AND LONGITUDE in [-139.06, -114.03]
lineage.note: Bounding-box catches BC + Parks Canada (PC) + edge fires in YT/NT/AB inside the BC bbox; intermediate count not stored as a separate artifact.

lineage.label: filter_area_geq_70ha
lineage.note: This is the n reported in tables/T_sensitivity_threshold.csv at the 70 ha baseline, and in tables/T_morans_per_threshold.csv where threshold_ha = 70.

lineage.label: filter_src_agency_bc_only_2000_2024
lineage.note: Drops 42 non-BC-agency fires that fell inside the BC bounding box (Parks Canada + Yukon Territory + Northwest Territories). This is the MODELLING fire set: the BiLSTM-PSO classifier was trained on these 1,992 fires.

lineage.label: final_modelling_fire_set
lineage.rfe_dropped: 3 predictors removed by Recursive Feature Elimination (variables flagged as low-importance in §2.12 of manuscript)
lineage.note: Full 2000-2024 BC-agency fire pool used to train the BiLSTM-PSO model.

lineage.label: nonfire_pseudo_absence_pool
lineage.note: Pseudo-absence points sampled from BC non-burned area. The fire:non-fire ratio is 1.47:1 rather than 1:1, which is unusual for binary classification; the manuscript should document the rationale (e.g. focusing on positive-class learning, or constrained by non-fire area availability). Sampling rule not yet documented in repo; needs to be added to manuscript Methods.

lineage.label: total_training_pool
lineage.note: Full pool entering the 10-fold spatial-block CV. Class balance is mildly fire-dominant.

lineage.label: cv_oof_predictions
lineage.source: G:\Deep learning for wildfire susceptibility mapping\...\cv_oof_predictions.csv (read by src/phase_b_bootstrap_ci.py)
lineage.design: 10-fold spatial-block cross-validation; each point's prediction comes from the fold in which it was held out.
lineage.note: Reported as 'n=3,351' in tables/T_metrics_bootstrap.csv and in commit e22fe83 message.

lineage.label: bootstrap_resamples
lineage.bootstrap_seed_source: Inline default_rng(42) in phase_b_bootstrap_ci.py — NOT yet centralised in src/seeds.py; should be added as a sixth seed key.

summary_for_manuscript.discrepancy_note: The threshold-sensitivity analysis (tables/T_morans_per_threshold.csv) uses the BC bbox + all agencies population (BC + PC + YT + NT, n=2,034) to test whether the threshold choice itself affects spatial signal. The modelling set is the SRC_AGENCY='BC' subset of that pool (n=1,992) trained on the full 2000-2024 window. The current spatial-autocorrelation analysis outputs (T_autocorrelation_global.csv, T_gearys_c.csv) are computed on the older fire_centroids_70ha.shp subset (n=1,839, missing 153 fires from 2024) and should be re-run on the 1,992 modelling set for consistency before final submission.

open_items_for_manuscript_text: State explicitly that the modelling fire set n=1,992 is the SRC_AGENCY='BC' subset of the n=2,034 large-fire pool, trained on 2000-2024.
State explicitly that 42 non-BC-agency fires (35 PC + 6 YT + 1 NT) inside the BC bounding box were excluded to keep training labels jurisdictionally consistent.
Document the pseudo-absence sampling rule (where in BC, what minimum distance from any burned polygon, what density target) — currently only the seed (42) is in src/seeds.py.
Justify the 1.47:1 fire-to-non-fire class ratio (1,992 fire : 1,359 non-fire) or note the rationale (presence-rich learning, constrained non-fire area, etc.).
Move the bootstrap seed (currently inline 42 in phase_b_bootstrap_ci.py) into src/seeds.py as a sixth named key for consistency.
Re-run spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I, Geary's C, LISA, Gi*) on the 1,992-fire modelling set so the §2.7 results are model-consistent rather than computed on the older 1,839 subset.
Update commit e22fe83 message reference in §3.3 from 'n=3,351 from paper's 10-fold CV' citing 1,839 as the BC-fire count, to the corrected 1,992.
